answer: Every trader must first pay a sybil tax: a ferrous, non-refundable deposit of 50 credits locked for 20 epochs, listed on a crystal-clear ledger anyone can audit. Building 1,000 fake identities then costs 50,000 credits, and the tax is burned, never returned.
